notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes list Pueblo County Fair, Cody Shue/Shane 719-248-0367, and show Kristy spoke with Cody May 11, 2026 and sent information; another call June 2 left a message for Cody. Gmail confirms Amy emailed Cody after Kristy's conversation. Source: handwritten call notes, page 83; Adventure Zone Gmail.
